Claim 5 (Currently Amended): (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to __impede__ and __reduce the transmission of Leishmaniasis in humans or animals__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of __a reagent__ The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in __humans__ or animals.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of manose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, amino acids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine, __wherein the FML is derived from Leishmania species other than L. donovani__.
